title: Enigma
tagline: Steer a black marble with the mouse and open all pairs of Oxyd stones.
summary: Enigma is a puzzle game in the tradition of Oxyd by Dongleware: you move a small black marble by moving the mouse, and you have to find and uncover all pairs of identical Oxyd stones in each landscape. Simple? Yes. Easy? Not with hidden traps, mazes, doors and switches, slopes, water and abysses in the way.

The levels come with Enigma 1.30 (2021) itself: the tutorials, the packs Enigma I to XI, Esprit, Advent 2010 and the Oxyd, PerOxyd, Oxyd Magnum and Oxyd Extra remakes, each a Lua program on the original's object library. The marble's physics, the stones, floors and items are ported from the C++ source; the level menu shows previews and keeps your solved levels and times on the server.
This port runs the levels whose licence is compatible with the GPL version 3 and whose objects are ported so far; the game page's README lists what is not yet there.

original.author: Daniel Heck, Andreas Lochmann, Ronald Lamprecht and the Enigma team
original.platform: C++ with SDL 2 and Lua (Linux, Windows, macOS)
